Let me try a configuration with a skip_connect on 3<-0 and convolutions elsewhere.

Thought: The configuration with skip_connect on 3<-0 improved performance to 0.915533 (91.55%). This matches the known optimal pattern in NAS-Bench-201. Let me try variations to see if I can do better. Let me try changing 2<-1 to nor_conv_1x1 or trying skip_connect on other edges.
